message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crime label(s) for this case.

Facts: In 2013 Oct, defendant Wang purchased from Shi a piece of forest land (林地) with 10 cubic meters of miscellaneous broadleaf forest, and obtained a logging permit for 10 cubic meters. He hired Yang to cut the forest, but did not clarify the scope, resulting in over-logging: actual harvested volume 40.202338 cubic meters, exceeding permit by about 30 cubic meters. So illegal over-logging.

What crime label? Options from correction lessons: there is "滥伐林木" (illegal logging beyond permit) used earlier for cases of cutting without permit. Also "非法采伐、毁坏国家重点保护植物" etc. But here they had a permit for 10 cubic meters, but exceeded. That is still illegal logging (over-logging). The label used earlier for similar: In earlier examples, "滥伐林木" used for cases where they cut without permit. Also "非法采伐、毁坏国家重点保护植物" used when protected species. Here it's just regular forest, not protected. So likely "滥伐林木". However there is also "非法占用农用地" etc. Not relevant.

Thus answer: [罪名]滥伐林木<eoa>

Check if any other label needed: maybe also "非法占用林地"? Not in list. The correction lessons mention "非法占用农用地" but not forest. So just one.
